The vendor directly providing **AISEO Art** at the domain **art.aiseo.ai** is **AISEO, Inc.** (operating under the brand **AISEO**).

### Evidence:
* **Product & Domain:** **AISEO Art** (`art.aiseo.ai`), an AI artwork and image generator tool hosted as part of the AISEO suite. The website displays the copyright notice: *"© AISEO Officials. All rights reserved."* and directs customer support inquiries to `support@aiseo.ai`.
* **Company / Legal Entity:** The official Terms & Conditions governing the platform define the operating entity: *"This includes emails, support tickets, and any other form of interaction with AISEO, Inc."* and state that *"AISEO.ai and its original content, features, and functionality are and will remain the exclusive property of AISEO and its licensors"*.
